candidates.concept: An adult couture engineer balances a shoulder-mounted fan of translucent volcanic-glass vanes while counterweights move along a blackened-steel fitting frame.
An adult model tests the opening cycle of an articulated obsidian-petal cape while an atelier technician tunes its visible brass linkages amid glassworking benches.
An adult designer conducts a controlled wind trial on a kinetic gown woven with glossy basalt-glass ribbons as numbered calibration flags flutter around the platform.
An adult performer slowly turns on a marked atelier dais while a motorized hem of smoked volcanic-glass prisms changes geometry under soft inspection lamps.
